tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App ground outside chat (Roadmap, Notebook, Settings). Also the 'day' ambient.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Buddy bubbles, cards, sheets, tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Composer field, code and trace blocks inside the X-ray sheet.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (fields, quiet buttons): ≥3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface, ambient, fog and soft tint in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, metadata, secondary lines; on surfaces and ambients (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: you
tokens.usage: The user's colour, written in ink: your bubbles, your rail on the roadmap, primary buttons, focus ring.

tokens.name: on-you
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `you` fill.

tokens.name: you-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows and your progress track; `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: The buddy's colour, a desk lamp: its avatar disc, its current station, and buddy-coloured marks. ≥4.5:1 on every surface and ambient in both themes (light: 5.0:1 on `surface`, 4.9:1 on `ambient-dawn`).

tokens.name: on-lamp
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `lamp` fill (light 5.6:1, dark 9.1:1).

tokens.name: lamp-soft
tokens.usage: Ritual and ask cards' header band, the buddy's progress track.

tokens.name: lamp-ink
tokens.usage: Buddy-coloured text and the buddy's roadmap rail; on surfaces and `lamp-soft`. In light it is `lamp` itself; in dark a touch lighter for small text.

tokens.name: lamp-glow
tokens.usage: Peak colour of the radial glow at the top of chat while the buddy is studying; fades to transparent. Only `ink` and `ink-muted` sit on it (≥4.5:1 at the peak in both themes); nothing lamp-coloured over it.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Veil over what the buddy can't see yet: locked topics, sealed notes.

tokens.name: fog-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `fog` (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Graphite: the edge of the shaky highlight where one is drawn; ≥3:1 on raised surfaces.

tokens.name: pencil-soft
tokens.usage: Highlighter wash behind the buddy's shaky parts; `ink` on it (light 11.7:1, dark 8.6:1). Only for `StudyNote.shaky` content.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: X-ray: audit pass. Always with the word 'pass'.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Behind `ok` text.

tokens.name: leak
tokens.usage: X-ray: audit found a leak; the fallback. Always with the word.

tokens.name: leak-soft
tokens.usage: Behind `leak` text.

tokens.name: unsure
tokens.usage: X-ray: 'unsure' classification and retries.

tokens.name: unsure-soft
tokens.usage: Behind `unsure` text.

tokens.name: ambient-dawn
tokens.usage: Chat ground 05:00–11:00 (morning ritual).

tokens.name: ambient-day
tokens.usage: Chat ground 11:00–17:00.

tokens.name: ambient-dusk
tokens.usage: Chat ground 17:00–21:00 (study share).

tokens.name: ambient-night
tokens.usage: Chat ground 21:00–05:00 (night review).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Parkinsans, used sparingly: screen titles, the buddy's name, section heads.

styles.name: display-light
styles.usage: The quiet half of a split-weight headline; the loud half is `display` at 700. One split headline per screen at most.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Topic and note titles, sheet titles.

styles.name: name
styles.usage: The buddy's name in the chat header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Encrypted doesn't mean private. With SSE-S3, anyone allowed to read gets it decrypted.

groups.name: Machine
groups.note: JetBrains Mono: the X-ray view and AWS identifiers.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: AWS names, ARNs, JSON in notes.

groups.name: Counter
groups.note: Parkinsans bold, tabular figures: only the day and streak numbers.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: The streak chip's large numeral and the Roadmap's day counter.

styles.name: counter-sm
styles.usage: The compact streak chip in the chat header.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between stacked bubbles from one sender; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Bubble padding (block); gaps inside rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter; bubble padding (inline); card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sender groups in chat.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above screen titles.

radius.note: Soft, with one sharp corner: a bubble's tail.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, the tail corner of a bubble.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fields, buttons, topic rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards (ritual, ask, note).

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles, except the tail corner.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the X-ray bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatar disc, streak chip, rail stations.

shadow.note: Borders do most of the separating; one real elevation for the floating sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: X-ray bottom sheet and anything that floats over chat.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard / D-pad focus: a surface gap then 2px of `you`. ≥8:1 on every surface.

fog.note: How far the fog hides things.

tokens.name: fog-blur
tokens.usage: Blur radius behind the fog veil (expo-blur intensity ≈ 40 on device).

tokens.name: fog-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the `fog` veil over locked content.
